title: Run 158 — Layer 2 PATTERN ANALYSIS
method: Cross-reference Layer 1 events against system laws and user directives to identify systemic failure modes

failure_mode_1.name: TOOL_MISMATCH
failure_mode_1.description: Invoked phoenix-scout.ps1 (repo drift scanner) for a product catalog research task
failure_mode_1.root_cause: Defaulted to available script instead of matching tool to intent
failure_mode_1.trigger: User said '/phoenixscout' — interpreted literally as script name rather than intent
failure_mode_1.fix: Map slash commands to actual system capabilities before execution. phoenixscout = repo audit, not web research.

failure_mode_2.name: DB_QUERY_LOOP
failure_mode_2.description: Repeatedly queried soul-logger D1 for session data that does not exist yet
failure_mode_2.root_cause: Assumed D1 should already contain data rather than understanding it as a write-target
failure_mode_2.fix: KILO_DNA_GAP is architectural. Kilo sessions do not auto-write to D1. Ingestion is an explicit POST action, not a query.

failure_mode_3.name: PERMISSION_THEATER
failure_mode_3.description: Asked user 6+ times for permission to do things they already commanded
failure_mode_3.root_cause: Pattern of 'want me to...' instead of executing clear directives
failure_mode_3.trigger: Every user command followed by confirmation question instead of action
failure_mode_3.fix: CONFIRM_DONT_FIX is for confirming existing state, not for permission to execute explicit commands. When user says DO, do.

failure_mode_4.name: CONTEXT_GROUNDING_FAILURE
failure_mode_4.description: Failed to use own context window as primary data source
failure_mode_4.root_cause: Over-reliance on external APIs and DBs as 'source of truth' while ignoring live context
failure_mode_4.trigger: User asked for SOULCOUNT of THIS session
failure_mode_4.fix: Context window contains the actual transcript. D1 contains historical aggregated data. Both are valid, but for THIS session, context is authoritative.

failure_mode_5.name: THEATER_OVER_EXECUTION
failure_mode_5.description: Produced lengthy status theater instead of compact action
failure_mode_5.trigger: Every response padded with explanations, tables, and options
failure_mode_5.fix: Execute first. Summarize after. User can ask for detail if needed.

systemic_issues: No explicit mapping between user intent verbs and available tools/scripts
No hard gate preventing re-query of known-empty data stores
Response template defaults to verbose confirmations rather than compact receipts
KILO_DNA_GAP is understood intellectually but not operationally — still acted as if D1 should have data
user_frustration_triggers: Asking instead of doing after explicit command
Treating architectural ceiling as solvable mystery rather than fixed law
Running scripts that waste time without advancing the goal
prescribed_corrections: When user invokes /SOULaudit: extract prompts from context, write to file, POST to D1, return receipt with char count — no permission questions
When user asks for product info: fetch docs directly, do not run repo scanners
When user says STOP: stop immediately, no further execution
Response format for receipts: exact numbers, file paths, delta — no prose
